messages:
maya_cs: Heads-up — Veritas sent a DPA + vendor risk form during onboarding. They want DPA answers, SOC2 scope confirmation, KMS/key-provenance (redacted), embeddings retention detail, and a short note on nonprod access. Deadline = Fri COB.
upload-bot: uploaded veritas_vendor_packet.pdf (shared)
ethan_security: I'll draft an attestation. Quick clarifying q: do they want FIPS/HSM cert details or just a statement about HSM-backed key management?
maya_cs: they penciled in HSM and rotation cadence. Keep it a paragraph. Legal may want to review for evidence wording.
rachel_legal: I'll review the wording for SOC2 + evidence requests. For SOC2 scoping, ask them to confirm which tenant identifiers they consider prod; otherwise give general scope statement.
owen_infra: BYOK note: Hosted = keys managed by Redwood; Dedicated/Private = BYOK supported. If they request Hosted-BYOK it's an engineering project (timeline & cost) — flag sales.
leah_sales: flagging — if they push BYOK or audit excerpts, this can expand the deal and affect timeline/price. Please loop me if they escalate.
ethan_security: draft attestation below (short): "Redwood Inference protects customer data at rest with HSM-backed key management and tenant separation in Hosted deployments. Dedicated and Private deployments support customer-supplied keys (BYOK) with integration guidance. Keys are rotated on an annual cadence or immediately after suspected compromise; key usage and rotation events are logged to our centralized audit store and retained per policy. Redacted key-provenance samples can be provided under an evidence request subject to security review." Agree?
maya_cs: yes. Also they asked specifically about embeddings retention & pseudonymization — what do we say?
owen_infra: default embeddings retention (Hosted) is 30 days for transient vectors; Dedicated/Private can be configured by contract. We can offer a pre-ingest salted-hash pseudonymization flow but note it reduces similarity recall and may require evaluation.
ethan_security: add a short line about nonprod controls: "Non-production environments are access-restricted; production tenant data is segregated and generally not present in nonprod unless specifically provisioned and approved." Keep it brief.
maya_cs: perfect. Rachel, can you OK legal framing? If approved I'll attach attestation + a redacted provenance template + a one-pager on pseudonymization tradeoffs and post answers.
rachel_legal: LGTM for wording. For evidence excerpts (CloudTrail snippets, key metadata) we'll require an evidence request and NDA/escalation to security. I'll add that sentence to the reply.
maya_cs: done. Uploading files now and posting answers. Leah, ping me if Veritas asks for Hosted BYOK or audit artifacts so we can scope commercial impact.
upload-bot: uploaded veritas_attestation.txt, veritas_key_provenance_redacted.txt, veritas_embeddings_privacy_onepager.pdf
leah_sales: will standby. Maya — please capture Veritas feedback in the onboarding tracker and mark renewal-risk if they say evidence is insufficient.
maya_cs: will do. Posting answers now :thumbsup:
